_note: § Each answer: 1–3 sentences, specific, from facts.md only. Groups and question keys are fixed. 'q' = question as a guest would ask it; 'a' = answer.
title: § 'Questions & answers'
intro: § 1 sentence: can't find it? message us.

whyDirect.q: § Why book direct instead of Booking.com?
whyDirect.a: § same rooms, best price, no fees, 20% off cruises, talk to the family

pay.a: § card online (deposit or full), or as agreed with us

cancel.a: § demo: free up to 14 days before arrival; we are flexible when we can

checkin.q: § What time is check-in and check-out?
checkin.a: § check-in 14:00–00:00, check-out by 10:00; tell us your arrival time; we try to help with luggage storage

late.q: § We land late at night. Is that OK?
late.a: § yes, family meets you; guests mention being welcomed late

cleaning.a: § yes, daily cleaning and fresh towels

kitchen.a: § every room has a kitchenette: fridge, kettle, coffee maker, cookware, hob; supermarkets nearby

wifi.a: § Aegealis: free Wi-Fi throughout (fine for messages, not heavy streaming); Theodora: free internet in the common areas

pool.a: § no own pool; Aegealis guests can use the pools of the two hotels next door; Theodora guests the neighbouring hotel's pool through the garden gate (subject to the hotel's season)

breakfast.a: § no; self-catering; at Aegealis the hotel next door serves a buffet breakfast you can pay for there; cafés nearby

parking.a: § Aegealis free public parking outside; Theodora no private parking, street parking nearby

kids.a: § yes, all ages; pricing ages per property

cot.q: § Can we have a cot or an extra bed?
cot.a: § Aegealis yes on request (prices); Theodora no

five.a: § Theodora two-bedroom apartment (up to 5), or two rooms

airport.a: § ~33 km, about 45 min; we can arrange a taxi

car.a: § not in Skala; both are walkable to beach, shops and tavernas; car useful for exploring

find.a: § use the map on our site; Aegealis is on the seafront road opposite the cruise kiosk; Theodora at the top of the main street

discount.q: § Do guests get a discount on cruises?
discount.a: § 20% off every cruise; second cruise 15% off for everyone

where.q: § Where does the boat leave from?
where.a: § Skala beach in front of Aegealis at 09:00; Poros 09:20 on Kefalonia & Ithaca routes

weather.q: § What if the weather is bad?
weather.a: § the Captain decides for safety; cancelled trips are moved or not charged

kids.a: § Ithaca and Fiscardo yes (slide!), children's fare 4–11; Zakynthos not recommended for small children

seasick.a: § Ithaca or Fiscardo along sheltered coast; stabilisers; avoid Zakynthos

lunch.a: § lunch ashore at your choice (Kioni, Fiscardo, Alykes); BBQ cruise includes food & wine; bars on board
